entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I assist you today?
Hi David, I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I got it about 18 days ago and it's not working as advertised.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. So I can best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a defect. The pulse readings are completely inaccurate, making the data useless. Frankly, the product is garbage.
I see. In that case, I can transfer you over to our technical support team. They can run some diagnostics with you to see if we can get it working properly.
No, thank you. I really don't have time for all that. The device doesn't work. I just want money back. Let's talk about a refund.
I understand your position, but our process for a defect claim outside the initial 10-day window requires verification from our tech team before we can authorize a return.

Okay, look, I'm not trying to be difficult, I just want a fair outcome. What if we skip the support call? If a full refund is off the table without that, what about a 75% store credit? Or a discount code for a future purchase? I'm sure we can work something out.

I appreciate you being willing to work with me. Let me just pull up the official policy here... one moment please... Okay. Actually, I see here that our return policy covers items for 90 days from the delivery date.
Yes. Since you received it 18 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. A negotiation isn't even necessary. I can approve a full refund for you right now.
Wow, okay. That's fantastic. I was prepared for a bigger discussion. A full refund is perfect, thank you.

You're very welcome. I've just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label in the next few minutes. Just pack the sensor back in its box, apply the label, and you can drop it off at the post office.
Simple enough. I appreciate you making that easy, David.
Of course. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
